name: Audacious Assault
description:
If you have at least one level of Swagger, make a melee weapon attack, skipping engagement and rolling Awe vs Awareness for the attack roll.

On a hit, roll and deal damage as normal. Then, if you have at least two levels of Swagger, you may make another attack in the same way against the same creature as a free action.

On a second hit, roll and deal damage as normal again. Then, if you have at least three levels of Swagger, repeat the attack a third time.

Describe your flourishes.
